notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are here to announce the release date for Seaside Cafe Story!

The game will be available at [u][b]November 4th at 7:00 PM PST![/b][/u] Be ready to open your seaside cafe and embark in an exciting and charming culinary adventure in Seaside Cafe Story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568780/ef214e476de57809e87ff64f6149d5416ca45413.jpg[/img]

[i]See you soon at the cafe!
[/i]

notes.title: Thank you for playing the demo!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38568780/8669069522c5b7db0ed21aab17e0df895bd8b72e.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, thank you for playing the short demo of Seaside Cafe Story. If you are wondering, the release date is very close and if you are interested with the game, don't forget to wishlist it!

With the Steam Demo Festival ended, so do the availability of the game demo on Steam. In the meantime, you can also follow the development of the game (and find alternative download link for the demo) on our various social media such as:

- [u][b][url=discord.gg/studionamaapa]Discord[/url][/b][/u]
- [b][u][url=https://twitter.com/studionamaapa]Twitter[/url][/u][/b]
- [b][u][url=https://www.facebook.com/seasidecafestory]Facebook[/url][/u][/b]

If you have suggestions or feedbacks for the game, feel free to comment below, start a thread in community discussion, or reach to us directly on our Discord server.

See you around at the release!
